title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction Bitcoin price held near $76,000 Thursday afternoon as the Nasdaq sank deeper into a correction, crypto liquidations topped $1 billion and Strategy, Coinbase and bitcoin miners sold off in double digits. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
